whenToUse: A four-step contact import: upload, map columns, fix validation errors, resolve duplicates.
CSV files with mixed encodings, delimiters and Turkish or English headers.
avoidWhen: A generic import flow component — use import-wizard.
A plain file drop without mapping — use file-upload.
a11y: Invalid cells use aria-invalid; F8 jumps to the next error and progress is in role="status".
Keep column-mapping selects labelled with the source header name.
